term_and_condition:
Welcome to Kamaleya! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals accessing or using the Program both as a merchant and an affiliate who refers customers to use a product or service from Kamaleya. 

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the program specified in the program and is bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

The affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link, and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

An affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customers both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

The affiliate may also advertise merchant websites on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to purchase on our website; you will get a commission amount calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...). The commission percentage will be 10% of the total sales by the affiliate. We expect a minimum sale of ₹.1000/- by the end of 30 days.

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. The payment schedule will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page, and affiliates will be notified about payments via email. 

Payments will be sent only for transactions that have been completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchants the right to review every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab; any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab.  Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banners, logo, or specific collection promotions through the Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code to share on affiliate channels. 

5. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to use cookies to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies, then we can't track them, so we can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies Policy is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start when a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at the merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link).

6. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can contact kamaleyacontact@gmail.com.

Go forward and refer!

We're delighted you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future, and if you have any questions, you can send an email to kamaleyacontact@gmail.com for support.
